documentType: Exact selected finding from sealed independent B; author input, not author independent judgment

finding.observation: The actual case specifies an air control with no relighting and a CO2-free limewater control. It specifies no damp splint, no splint moisture and no damp-splint control. The reference response nevertheless claims that the controls show a damp splint does not respond without the appropriate gas.
finding.requiredCorrection: Replace only the unsupported control sentence in both languages and matching complete-case response. Explain that the supplied air control does not relight the splint under those conditions and the CO2-free blank stays clear; do not infer an unreported moisture control. Recheck the changed material/profile bindings with a new version.
